faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the ThinkPad T440, T450, X240 and related series (external, 68+ battery). Note these models use two batteries — this listing is for the external, swappable one. The part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
